name: First public movie screening
description: The Lumière brothers hold the first public screening of a film in Paris.

name: Birth of Bollywood
description: The Indian film industry, also known as Bollywood, is established.

name: Birth of Hollywood
description: The Hollywood film industry is established in Los Angeles, California.

name: The Jazz Singer
description: The first feature-length motion picture with synchronized dialogue sequences, The Jazz Singer, is released.

name: Golden Age of Hollywood
description: The 1930s to 1950s are considered the Golden Age of Hollywood, with the production of numerous classic films.

name: Citizen Kane
description: Citizen Kane, often regarded as one of the greatest films ever made, is released.

name: Birth of New Hollywood
description: A new era in American filmmaking begins, known as the New Hollywood.

name: First Star Wars film
description: The first Star Wars film, Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope, is released to critical and commercial success.

name: Birth of Pixar Animation Studios
description: Pixar Animation Studios is founded, paving the way for computer-animated films.

name: Jurassic Park
description: Jurassic Park revolutionizes visual effects in film with its realistic portrayal of dinosaurs.

name: The Lord of the Rings trilogy
description: The Lord of the Rings film trilogy, based on J.R.R. Tolkien's novel, becomes a critical and commercial success.

name: Marvel Cinematic Universe
description: The Marvel Cinematic Universe begins with the release of Iron Man, kickstarting a series of interconnected superhero films.

name: Avatar
description: Avatar, directed by James Cameron, becomes the highest-grossing film of all time upon its release.

name: Inception
description: Inception, directed by Christopher Nolan, explores the concept of shared dreaming and becomes a critical and commercial success.

name: The Hunger Games
description: The film adaptation of The Hunger Games, based on the popular book series, sparks a successful film franchise.

name: Frozen
description: Frozen, a Disney animated film, becomes a global phenomenon and the highest-grossing animated film at the time of its release.

name: La La Land
description: La La Land, a modern musical film, receives critical acclaim and wins multiple Academy Awards.

name: Black Panther
description: Black Panther, a superhero film with a predominantly Black cast, becomes a cultural phenomenon and a major box office success.

name: Parasite
description: Parasite, a South Korean film directed by Bong Joon-ho, wins the Palme d'Or at the Cannes Film Festival and Best Picture at the Academy Awards.

name: COVID-19 Impact
description: The COVID-19 pandemic disrupts film production and leads to the closure of movie theaters worldwide.
